plain_description.what: Changes the self-test of the version-2 architecture pilot tool so it uses a fixed test date instead of the real calendar date. Then checks that all 282 checks pass on any day. No calls.
plain_description.why: Some self-test checks depended on today's date, so the suite could fail or skip checks on the wrong day. Other work needed date-independent tests.
plain_description.information: Passing means the self-test is reproducible whatever the date. Result: done and merged. 282 checks pass, 0 fail, on any date. One limit stays open: the self-test cannot yet catch a future slip back to the real clock. A follow-up trap test was drafted for that.
